messages:
Lina (product): quick sync  customer asks: rolling upgrades that preserve tenant egress IPs + a slim installer mode. how do we scope this for roadmap?
Diego (eng): core risks: KV cache invalidation and drain order for serving pods. two engineering approaches: operator-orchestrated rollout or rolling sidecar replace. operator is safer for canaries.
Sam (netops): egress preservation is a hard requirement for some accounts. proposal: support customer-managed NAT as primary, and our relay as fallback. include BGP and static-route examples in docs.
Jill (devops): packaging plan: three installer presets - full, slim, airgap. slim must expose a post-install IP-pin check and an opt-in flag. CI should run slim smoke tests.
Lina (product): suggested launch criteria: 1) rolling upgrade without >1min p99 latency spike; 2) pinned tenants retain egress IPs; 3) slim validated in >=2 field pilots; 4) canary + rollback runbook published.
Diego (eng): estimate: operator + canary infra ~4 sprints (2 engs), packaging ~1 sprint (1 eng), netops docs + validation ~0.5 sprint + 2 weeks field validation.
Sam (netops): will draft runbook snippets: BGP neighbor example and iptables fallback. include minimal validation commands.
Jill (devops): I'll prototype `--force-ip-check` and the slim installer flags this week.
ops-bot: created ticket RDW-5782: "private-deploy: rolling-upgrade + egress-pin" assigned to Lina, Diego, Sam, Jill. :white_check_mark:
Lina (product): thanks all  i'll add to roadmap and schedule a 30m walkthrough next Mon. end.
